title: 第1697章 气运玄龙第1696章 雷皇玺
lines: “霆风道友客气，道友乃是雷皇之弟子，理应代替雷皇，与我等一同召唤气运玄龙。”
轩辕圣皇一笑道。
玄道圣皇与黑玄圣皇亦是微微颔首，月灵圣皇自然不会露出什么不好的神色，同样螓首一点。
“既然人都到齐了，便开始吧，不然待会儿时辰便过了。”她反而开口催促起来。
“哈哈……灵皇所言极是，既如此，便开始吧。”轩辕圣皇大笑一声，旋即脚下一动，便落在了天穹上缓缓旋转的白云正下方。
其手指捏诀，脚下一踏，一阵古老的灵纹自脚下蔓延，眨眼之间便蔓延百丈，一股厚重如山的气息顿时弥漫开来。
同时一道黄色光柱也冲天而起，直至那云层之中。
另外三位圣皇与霆风尊者见此，也不甘落后，各自占据方位，正好立于轩辕圣皇四方。
灵皇娇喝一声，小手一挥，一片绿光环绕周身，灵纹蔓延，生生不息。
黑皇双掌一合，身后似浮现一尊滔天战影，接着又瞬间缩回体内，下一瞬，一阵黑色灵纹自脚下浮现，如水荡漾，如渊深邃。
玄皇手指捏诀，白色玄光锋芒尽现，好似要撕开周身的虚空，继而一道白色灵纹也席卷开来。
同一时间，三道光柱也没入天穹之中。
那苍茫无尽的天穹之上，浓厚的白云之下，一方更大灵纹缓缓出现，没有天地灵气的凝聚，更无天地元气的汹涌，只有一股玄之又玄的力量笼罩在所有人的心头。
而这时，广场周围的修士望着那天穹上方法阵，却忽然变得凝重起来，尤其是诸多世家之人。
无他，那看似浩瀚的法阵，分明有一处位置变得虚幻起来，好似缺了一角一般，而那股弥漫天地的力量似也要从此处流失而去。
倘若当真如此，那气运玄龙恐怕就唤之不出了。
“霆锋道友，还不出手，更待何时！”轩辕圣皇这时蓦然一喝。
另一方位的蓝袍男子这才微微颔首，手指捏诀，祭出了掌中的雷皇玺。
一道惊雷炸响，那湛蓝的方玺立马悬浮空中，继而一转之下，骤然暴涨，化作百丈大小，众人这才看清，那玺印之上赫然匍匐着一尊模样狰狞的古兽。
雷霆环身，霹雳无间。
接着那古兽好似活过来一般，竟蓦然起身，仰天长啸。
伴随着“吼”的巨响，一圈圈肉眼可见的声波席卷四方，甚至还夹杂着丝丝雷弧，令人望而生畏。
接着，玄光自起，一圈雷纹浮现，同时一道恍若雷霆的光柱也冲天而起。
天穹上那摇摇欲坠的法阵也终是补全了缺陷。
哪怕仍有瑕疵，无法完美融合，却也足以维持运转了。
“古雷兽？”王扶则盯着那雷皇玺上盘旋的狰狞雷兽，若有所思。
不过不等他多想，一阵“轰”的巨响自天穹上传开。
那巨大的法阵中赫然迸发阵阵霞光，接着一尊庞大的虚影好似跨越重重虚空降临而来，当法阵破碎，白云低垂之时，那虚影凝实，赫然是一尊蜿蜒云端的白色巨龙。
唯龙首自云中探出，可即便如此，也有一股无与伦比的压迫感。
庞大的龙首宛若一尊山岳一般。
只是随意一扫，与之对视的修士都瞬间激灵一下，打了个冷战，如坠冰窖，便是王扶也有种浑身一滞的错觉。
“大乘境……”王扶轻吸一口凉气，瞳孔微缩，也瞬间明白此龙的境界。
尽管早知这气运玄龙必然不凡，不曾想还是远远低估了。
如此看来，人族远不止表面上这么简单，虽只有三位大乘修士，可这气运玄龙也绝对是一尊堪比大乘境的战力。
“恭迎玄龙大人降临！”轩辕圣皇脚下的灵纹消失，其位于那龙首之下，当即双手一拱的开口。
content_en:
"Fellow Taoist Tingfeng is polite. You are a disciple of the Thunder Emperor. You should replace the Thunder Emperor and summon the Luck Black Dragon together with us."
Holy Emperor Xuanyuan smiled.
The Holy Emperor Xuan Dao and the Holy Emperor Black Xuan also nodded slightly. The Holy Emperor Yueling naturally did not show any bad expressions and also nodded slightly.
"Now that everyone is here, let's start, otherwise the time will pass later." Instead, she began to urge.
"Haha... what the Spirit Emperor said is absolutely true. In that case, let's get started." Holy Emperor Xuanyuan laughed, and immediately moved his feet, landing directly under the slowly rotating white clouds in the sky.
He squeezed the secret with his fingers and stepped on it. A burst of ancient spiritual patterns spread from his feet. In the blink of an eye, they spread hundreds of feet, and a breath as thick as a mountain suddenly filled the air.
At the same time, a yellow beam of light also rose into the sky and reached into the clouds.
Seeing this, the other three Holy Emperors and Lord Tingfeng were not willing to lag behind. They each took their positions and stood exactly on the four sides of Xuanyuan Holy Emperor.
The Spirit Emperor gave a sweet shout, waved his little hand, and a green light surrounded him, and the spirit patterns spread endlessly.
The Black Emperor clasped his palms together, and a monstrous war shadow seemed to appear behind him, and then retracted into his body in an instant. The next moment, a burst of black spiritual patterns emerged from under his feet, like rippling water, like the depth of an abyss.
Emperor Xuan kneaded the secret with his fingers, and the sharp white mysterious light appeared, as if it was about to tear apart the void around him, and then a white spiritual pattern swept away.
At the same time, the three light pillars did not enter the sky.
Above the boundless sky, under the thick white clouds, a larger spiritual pattern slowly appeared. There was no condensation of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, let alone the surge of vitality of heaven and earth. There was only a mysterious and mysterious power that shrouded everyone's hearts.
At this time, the monks around the square looked at the formation on the sky and suddenly became solemn, especially those from many aristocratic families.
Without him, the seemingly vast array clearly became illusory in one place, as if a corner was missing, and the power that permeated the world seemed to be drained away from here.
If this is really the case, then the Qi Luck Black Dragon may not be able to be summoned.
"Fellow Taoist Tingfeng, if you don't take action yet, wait until when!" Holy Emperor Xuanyuan suddenly shouted at this time.
The man in blue robe on the other side nodded slightly, kneaded his fingers, and released the Thunder Emperor's Seal in his palm.
There was a thunderous explosion, and the azure square seal immediately floated in the air. Then, with a twist, it suddenly swelled and became a hundred feet in size. Only then did everyone see clearly that there was a ferocious ancient beast crawling on the seal.
Thunder surrounds the body, and thunderbolts are endless.
Then the ancient beast seemed to come to life, suddenly stood up, looked up to the sky and roared.
Accompanied by the loud "roar", circles of sound waves visible to the naked eye swept across all directions, even mixed with traces of lightning arcs, which was daunting.
Then, the mysterious light rose up, a circle of thunder patterns emerged, and at the same time, a lightning-like light pillar also rose into the sky.
The crumbling magic circle in the sky finally made up for its shortcomings.
Even if there are still flaws and cannot be perfectly integrated, it is enough to maintain operation.
"Ancient thunder beast?" Wang Fuze stared at the ferocious thunder beast hovering on the Thunder Emperor's Seal, thoughtfully.
But before he could think about it, a loud "boom" sound spread from the sky.
Bursts of rays of light suddenly burst out from the huge magic circle, and then a huge phantom seemed to come across the void. When the magic circle shattered and the white clouds hung low, the phantom solidified, and it turned out to be a giant white dragon winding in the clouds.
Only the dragon's head poked out from the clouds, but even so, there was an unparalleled sense of oppression.
The huge dragon head is like a mountain.
With just a casual sweep, the monks who looked at him were instantly excited and shivered, as if they had fallen into an ice cellar. Even Wang Fu felt as if he was stagnant.
"The Mahayana realm..." Wang Fu took a deep breath, his pupils narrowed slightly, and he instantly understood the realm of this dragon.
Although I had known that this destiny dragon must be extraordinary, I never thought that it was still far underestimated.
From this point of view, the human race is much more than what it appears on the surface. Although there are only three Mahayana monks, this Qi Luck Black Dragon is definitely a fighting force comparable to the Mahayana realm.
"Welcome to the Lord Xuanlong!" The spiritual patterns at Xuanyuan Holy Emperor's feet disappeared, and he was located under the dragon head. He immediately raised his hands and spoke.
title_en: Chapter 1697 Luck Black Dragon Chapter 1696 Thunder Emperor's Seal
